scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to weird integers of the form \(2^k p q\). It gives a uniform improvement of the proved abundance upper bound but does not prove Iannucci's sharper conjecture or any existence statement. The infinite claim is established by an elementary argument from the published exact criterion; a finite replay through \(k=8\) is corroborative only. Focused source, alias, implication, and database searches found no equivalent bound, with residual risk from differently phrased or poorly indexed literature.
title: A uniform three-quarter abundance bound for weird numbers of form \(2^k p q\)
